name: Imatinib (Gleevec)
description: Commercial FDA-Approved Pharmacopoeia Standard indicated for Chronic Myeloid Leukemia (CML) across chronic, accelerated, and blast phases, Philadelphia chromosome-positive acute lymphoblastic leukemia, and gastrointestinal stromal tumors (GIST). Mechanistically, it functions as a potent small-molecule inhibitor that competitively blocks the ATP-binding catalytic pocket of the BCR-ABL fusion protein, c-Kit, and PDGF-R receptors, effectively halting downstream mitogenic signaling cascades and inducing apoptosis in malignant clones.

name: Vyom-Cosmic-BRAF-V600E-Core-36351
description: Advanced In-Silico Pipeline Discovery engineered via harmonic dyadic field equations. Mechanistically, it executes precise resonance frequency tuning and ATP-competitive active site blockade that completely neutralizes hyperactivated MAPK/ERK signaling cascades, reversing oncogenic transcription and driving tumor regression.

name: Vyom-Cosmic-PI3K-Alpha-Mod-87923
